# dokploy_users (Data Source)

Fetches all users from Dokploy. Use this data source to discover user IDs for permission management.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "dokploy_users" "all" {}

# Output all user IDs
output "user_ids" {
  value = { for u in data.dokploy_users.all.users : u.email => u.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) List of all users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the user.
- `email` (String) The email of the user.
- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the user's email is verified.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the user.
- `image` (String) The profile image URL of the user.
- `is_registered` (Boolean) Whether the user has completed registration.
- `name` (String) The name of the user.
- `role` (String) The role of the user.
- `two_factor_enabled` (Boolean) Whether two-factor authentication is enabled.
